content:
Stack: plain HTML and CSS in one file (index.html, about 8 KB, inline CSS, no JavaScript), because a single page of four links needs no framework or build step, and that is the surest way to load in under a second on 3G.
Content: name, the bio line as written, handle @rumana.akter once in small type; four links in the brief's order, numbered 01–04, each with a short note (Portfolio note written: "Ship-breaking yards, Fishery Ghat, the hill tracts"; Contact note: the email address).
Fonts: device fonts only (serif for name and bio, sans for links, mono for numbers and handle). Colours: warm paper and ink with a rust accent, plus a dark version following prefers-color-scheme.
Layout: phone, small portrait beside the name; desktop, two columns (large portrait, name and bio left, links right, bottom-aligned).
Portrait: 4:5 box, muted gradient with a thin inner frame until portrait.jpg arrives; CSS background with role="img" and label "Rumana Akter, portrait"; preloaded (404 until supplied).
Motion (Tier 1, CSS only): hover (pointer devices) sweeps an ink panel from the left, text turns light, number turns rust, arrow nudges (diagonal on Contact); keyboard focus shows the same panel plus a 3px rust outline; press sinks the row 1px and flashes rust; nothing moves on its own; reduced motion switches it off. Skip link; forced-colors support.
Checked (Playwright, Chromium): every link ≥ 73px tall and full content width; no horizontal overflow at 320, 375, 1440; screenshots at 375 full, 375 focus, 1440 hover. Not checked: dark mode, reduced motion, a real Slow 3G Lighthouse run.

content:
Route: full (new page). Tier 1 — Basic (CSS only): hover, focus-visible and press are the only motion; nothing on its own, nothing scroll-driven, no WebGL, no JavaScript.
MOTOMATION PLAN
Stack       : plain HTML/CSS ("you choose") → adapters/vanilla.md
Tension     : slow, careful work from the yards and markets ↔ a visitor on a weak signal with two seconds and one thumb
Concept     : The page is one printed tally slip, like the ones clerks tear off at the yard gate; the line you touch prints black under your thumb
Archetype   : seed 9101 draw gave Timeline, which fails (no dates in the brief; inventing them is banned) → its printed fallback, Ledger, mutated by "single object"
Collision   : receipt printer → "paper feeding line by line": numbered lines, dashed tear rules, sawtooth edges, paper feeds up on press
Signature   : thermal-feed: a print-head wipe (clip-path, 200ms) prints the row paper-on-black; Contact prints on a red end-of-roll stripe
Dials       : ENERGY 1 · RHYTHM 1 · MOTION 1 → Tier 1
Type mode   : SERVICE STYLE
Type        : Martian Mono, one 3.3 KB subset, swap, preloaded / platform serif and mono stacks
Palette     : paper #F2EEE5, ink #191A18, muted #5A5850, accent #A8361C on steel #1F2120
Not doing   : round avatar with pill buttons and social icons
Stack and why: plain HTML/CSS: one page, four links, under 1 s on 3G with no JS needed; a single static file with inline CSS is the smallest thing that can paint. The gate's 2 KB "JS" is the JSON-LD block. Pre-paint weight about 7.8 KB (3.8 KB HTML gzipped, 3.3 KB font, 0.7 KB portrait placeholder). Lighthouse Slow 3G not run.
Assumption: page served at the root of rumana-akter.example.com, so Portfolio, Prints and Workshops use /work, /prints, /workshops (also needed for the gate's ≥ 3 internal links rule). On another domain, change them to the absolute URLs.
Files: index.html, DESIGN.md, fonts/martian-mono-400.woff2 (loaded), fonts/martian-mono-subset.woff2 (source, not loaded), portrait.jpg, portrait.webp, portrait-400.webp, og-image.jpg (placeholders), _headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, .motomation/log.json. No MOTION.md.
Gate: PASS on first run; after small fixes (44px skip link, larger desktop name, slip centred) re-run PASS, --verify: STAMP VERIFIED · gate PASS.
